clamp.note: Clamp long captions to N lines with ellipsis. The snippet reflects the current selection.

loading-text.description: Animated loading caption that sweeps a shimmer across short text to communicate an in-progress operation.

dots.note: Three decorative pulsing dots after the text — hidden from assistive technology, static under reduced motion.

examples.note: Default text and custom text. The snippet shows the minimal template.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris UI package and import the loading-text component.

props.note: Full props reference lives in the component documentation.

size-density.note: By default the text inherits the surrounding font-size/line-height. size/density below are opt-in fixed overrides. The snippet reflects the current selection.

speeds.note: Shimmer sweep speed. The snippet reflects the current selection.
